crossRefs.note: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin…

translations.web: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
translations.bsb: He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people,
translations.kjv: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
translations.asv: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.
